sn35.69:1.4: This illustrates the differences between _bāhira_ (“exterior”) and _bahiddha_ (“external, outside”). Typically what is _bāhira_ is the outside of an organism or a single thing (such as an altar), whereas _bahiddha_ is something outside a point of reference or removed past a boundary. That is, interior/exterior are two aspects of a single thing, whereas inside/outside are two distinct things.
